acceptance.basis: Same fixed engineering limits as the preceding plane study, committed before this study runs; not publisher guarantees.

calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

generation: Same fixed native keyframe registration and unchanged 50% geometric acceptance. Promote every 30 accepted poses or immediately after an accepted pose has less than 75% support in the active keyframe. Promotion uses only current geometric support, never future/reference poses. A failed registration still ends the chain; there is no second attempt, fallback or reset.
redirect_basis: Official host observed for previous xyz/rpy; this sequence request is verified at acquisition.
